column1: # Dota 2 7.42a, Steam build 26936712, Client/Server 6997, SourceRevision 11278692, dedicated dota map.

# B6 courier radius: time, event, displacement/elapsed probe seconds, speed, native aura seconds remaining, distance from fountain.
# B7 auras: time, event, attack speed multiplier, armor and native enemy aura modifier flags.
# B7 Hivemind: time, event, maximum health, cast range bonus, active modifier names.
# B8 Harpoon: time, event, case, stage, caster x, target x/y, cooldown, caster mana, rooted and debuff immunity.
